import bpy,json,math,heapq
from mathutils import Vector,Matrix
from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['access16'];craft=ns['craft'];cap=ns['cap'];bank=ns['bank'];oldtree=ns['old_ground_tree']
assert not craft.get('access16_stairs'), 'Already moved; inspect before repeating'
def sm(a,b,x):
 t=max(0,min(1,(x-a)/(b-a)));return t*t*(3-2*t)
def ground(tree,x,y):
 hit=tree.ray_cast(Vector((x,y,9)),Vector((0,0,-1)),20)[0]
 assert hit is not None,(x,y)
 return hit.z
# Keep each existing stone, UV, bevel and material; turn the flight toward the shore.
steps=sorted([o for o in craft.objects if o.name.startswith('Combined_front_A outer steps')],key=lambda o:o.name)
assert len(steps)==5
changes=[]
for i,o in enumerate(steps):
 before=list(o.location);o.rotation_euler.z=math.pi/2;o.location.x=4.63+.28*i;o.location.y=-3.15
 changes.append({'name':o.name,'before':before,'after':list(o.location),'top':1.48-.2*i})
# Regrade the existing bank below the flight and its dry landing, preserving the perimeter.
me=bank.data;oldcoords=[v.co.copy() for v in me.vertices];edges={};adj=[{} for v in me.vertices]
for p in me.polygons:
 vs=list(p.vertices)
 for a,b in zip(vs,vs[1:]+vs[:1]):
  e=tuple(sorted((a,b)));edges[e]=edges.get(e,0)+1
  d=(me.vertices[a].co.xy-me.vertices[b].co.xy).length;adj[a][b]=d;adj[b][a]=d
boundary={i for e,n in edges.items() if n==1 for i in e}
outer={i for i in boundary if not (abs(abs(me.vertices[i].co.x)-4.48)<.025 and me.vertices[i].co.y<2.68)}
dists=[float('inf')]*len(me.vertices);q=[]
for i in outer:dists[i]=0;heapq.heappush(q,(0,i))
while q:
 d,i=heapq.heappop(q)
 if d>dists[i]:continue
 for j,dd in adj[i].items():
  if d+dd<dists[j]:dists[j]=d+dd;heapq.heappush(q,(d+dd,j))
for i,v in enumerate(me.vertices):
 x,y,z=v.co
 weight=sm(4.45,4.52,x)*(1-sm(6.35,7.35,x))*(1-sm(.70,1.17,abs(y+3.15)))*sm(0,.45,dists[i])
 target=1.39-(x-4.63)*(.2/.28) if x<5.9 else .482857-.08*(x-5.9)
 v.co.z=z*(1-weight)+target*weight
me.update()
for p in me.polygons:p.use_smooth=True
newtree=BVHTree.FromPolygons([bank.matrix_world@v.co for v in me.vertices],[list(p.vertices) for p in me.polygons])
plant_moves=[]
for i,(oldxy,newxy) in enumerate([((5.06,-3.18),(5.00,-4.25)),((5.72,-3.36),(5.75,-4.15)),((6.28,-2.91),(6.75,-1.65)),((5.47,-2.68),(5.48,-2.05))]):
 oldh=ground(oldtree,*oldxy);newh=ground(newtree,*newxy);delta=Vector((newxy[0]-oldxy[0],newxy[1]-oldxy[1],newh-oldh))
 obs=[o for o in craft.objects if o.name.startswith('S15 salt shoulder bed '+str(i)+' leaf')];assert len(obs)==7
 for o in obs:o.location+=delta
 plant_moves.append({'bed':i,'before':[*oldxy,oldh],'after':[*newxy,newh]})
bpy.context.view_layer.update()
checks=[]
for i in outer:assert abs(me.vertices[i].co.z-oldcoords[i].z)<1e-7
checks.append('Bank outer seam unchanged')
for x,y in [(6.16,-.4),(4.55,1.7),(5.1,2.2),(4.6,4.7),(4.2,3.6)]:assert abs(ground(newtree,x,y)-ground(oldtree,x,y))<1e-5
checks.append('Existing upper side stair and props remain supported')
assert min(p.normal.z for p in me.polygons)>.005
checks.append('Bank faces upward')
flight=[]
for i,o in enumerate(steps):
 samples=[ground(newtree,o.location.x,yy) for yy in [-3.63,-3.15,-2.67]]
 top=1.48-.2*i
 assert max(samples)<top-.015,(i,samples,top)
 flight.append({'step':i,'top':top,'ground':samples})
checks.append('All five treads clear the bank')
foot=[{'xy':[x,y],'ground':ground(newtree,x,y)} for x,y in [(6.03,-3.15),(6.5,-3.15),(6.9,-3.15)]]
assert .1<.68-foot[0]['ground']<.25,foot
checks.append('Bottom riser meets a walkable dry landing')
allowed=[o.name for o in steps]+[bank.name]+[o.name for o in craft.objects if any(o.name.startswith('S15 salt shoulder bed '+str(i)+' leaf') for i in range(4))]
report={'steps':changes,'flight_ground':flight,'landing':foot,'plant_moves':plant_moves,'changed_bank_vertices':sum((v.co-oldcoords[i]).length>1e-6 for i,v in enumerate(me.vertices)),'outer_vertices_unchanged':len(outer),'allowed_changed_objects':allowed,'checks':checks}
(cap/'access_fit.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
craft['access16_stairs']=True;ns['ground_tree']=newtree;ns['steps']=steps;ns['report']=report
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
print('ACCESS16_MOVED',len(steps),'stones; bank',report['changed_bank_vertices'],'vertices;',len(checks),'checks')
print('LANDING',foot)
